nodes.description: msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used as sender in _transfer/transferFrom and as the unlock authority (msg.sender)
block.timestamp; used for ownership lock timing and as swap/addLiquidity deadline
Ownable._owner; privileged address checked by onlyOwner and reassigned by lock/unlock
Ownable._lockTime; timestamp until which ownership unlock is blocked
_totalSupply = 1e27; fixed token supply minted to deployer in constructor
_balances mapping; token balances mutated inside transfer logic
_allowances mapping; spender approvals mutated by _approve/transferFrom
_tax; aggregated fee percentage used as divisor in fee and swap math
_antisniperblock = _tax + _antidump; extra fee applied when recipient is the pair
_liquidityFee; liquidity portion of the tax, used as divisor in swapAndLiquify
_marketingFee; marketing portion of the tax, writable by owner via setTaxes
_giveawayFee; giveaway portion of the tax, used in swapAndLiquify distribution
_maxtrx; maximum per-transaction amount, owner configurable
_walletMax; maximum wallet holding when checkWalletLimit is enabled
minimumTokensBeforeSwap; contract balance threshold that triggers swapAndLiquify
isBlacklisted mapping; blacklisted addresses are blocked in _transfer, owner controlled
isExcludedFromFee mapping; exempt addresses bypass takeFee
isWalletLimitExempt mapping; exempt addresses skip the wallet max check
inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap
uniswapV2Router; external router used for swaps and liquidity, owner replaceable
uniswapV2Pair; pair address used for sell detection in takeFee
marketingWalletAddress; ETH recipient for marketing fees
giveawayWalletAddress; ETH recipient for giveaway fees
swapAndLiquifyEnabled; owner toggle gating automatic swap in _transfer
checkWalletLimit; owner toggle gating the wallet max enforcement
_transfer: core transfer path; fee logic, wallet limit, and automatic swapAndLiquify trigger
takeFee: computes fee from _tax or _antisniperblock, credits contract balance, returns net amount
swapAndLiquify: lockTheSwap protected distribution of contract tokens into ETH/liquidity
swapTokensForEth: approves router and performs external swap with block.timestamp deadline
addLiquidity: approves router and adds token/ETH liquidity externally
transferToAddressETH: private ETH payout to marketing/giveaway wallet via transfer()
changeRouterVersion: owner-only replacement of router and pair addresses
unlock: restores _previousOwner if caller matches and lock time elapsed
lock: owner-only ownership time lock using block.timestamp
transfer: ERC20 entrypoint forwarding _msgSender to _transfer
transferFrom: ERC20 entrypoint that spends allowance and forwards to _transfer
_basicTransfer: fee-free balance move used while inSwapAndLiquify is true
_approve: writes _allowances and emits Approval
setTaxes: owner-only update of fee percentages and derived _tax/_antisniperblock
blacklistAddress: owner-only toggling of isBlacklisted for an account
setIsExcludedFromFee: owner-only toggling of fee exemption
constructor: deploys pair, sets router, exemptions, and allocates total supply
receive: payable ETH reception from the router during swaps
recipient.transfer(amount): raw ETH send to an arbitrary payout address
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external call with 0 min out
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value:ethAmount} external call with 0 slippage bounds
sender parameter of _transfer
recipient parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer/takeFee/transfer/transferFrom
finalAmount local computed after fee deduction in _transfer
contractTokenBalance local read from balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer
feeAmount local computed in takeFee
tAmount parameter of swapAndLiquify
tokensForLP local split off for liquidity in swapAndLiquify
amountReceived local ETH balance read in swapAndLiquify
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth
ethAmount parameter of addLiquidity
newRouterAddress parameter of changeRouterVersion
time parameter of lock
account parameter of blacklistAddress

edges.reason: msg.sender (_msgSender) is passed as the sender argument into _transfer
unlock authorizes callers by comparing _previousOwner with msg.sender
lock computes _lockTime from block.timestamp and user supplied time
unlock gate depends on block.timestamp > _lockTime (timestamp dependency)
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline
unlock reads and rewrites _owner from _previousOwner
lock stores _owner into _previousOwner and zeroes _owner
unlock requires block.timestamp greater than stored _lockTime
lock writes _lockTime state variable
constructor mints _totalSupply to the deployer and approves the router
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient
takeFee credits the contract entry of _balances with the fee
_basicTransfer moves _balances without fees
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance from _allowances
takeFee divides amount by _tax; _tax can be zero via setTaxes causing division by zero
swapAndLiquify divides by _tax in fee split arithmetic
takeFee multiplies by _antisniperblock for pair sells
swapAndLiquify divides by _liquidityFee.div(2) derived totalETHFee
swapAndLiquify computes giveaway share from _giveawayFee
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxtrx for non-owner transfers
_transfer enforces recipient balance <= _walletMax when checkWalletLimit
_transfer compares contract balance against minimumTokensBeforeSwap
_transfer blocks blacklisted sender/recipient via isBlacklisted (owner controlled)
_transfer reads isExcludedFromFee to decide whether takeFee is applied
_transfer reads isWalletLimitExempt to bypass the wallet max check
inSwapAndLiquify guard branches _transfer into _basicTransfer to avoid reentrant fee/sell logic
lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwapAndLiquify around swapAndLiquify
swapTokensForEth calls the stored uniswapV2Router and reads its WETH
addLiquidity calls the stored uniswapV2Router for liquidity provisioning
_transfer skips auto-swap when sender equals uniswapV2Pair
takeFee applies the higher _antisniperblock rate when recipient equals uniswapV2Pair
marketingWalletAddress is the payout recipient of transferToAddressETH
giveawayWalletAddress is the payout recipient of transferToAddressETH
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer
checkWalletLimit gates the wallet max enforcement in _transfer
_transfer delegates to _basicTransfer when inSwapAndLiquify is true
_transfer calls takeFee for non-exempt transfers
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when contract balance exceeds the minimum
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth for the swap portion
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity for the liquidity portion
swapAndLiquify calls transferToAddressETH for marketing and giveaway payouts
transfer forwards to _transfer
transferFrom forwards to _transfer
transferFrom reduces allowance through _approve
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap unsafe operation
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH unsafe operation
transferToAddressETH performs the raw ETH transfer unsafe operation
setTaxes recomputes _tax from owner supplied fee values
blacklistAddress writes isBlacklisted for the supplied account
setIsExcludedFromFee writes the fee exemption mapping
constructor sets uniswapV2Router and the internal router allowance
ETH payout to a contract recipient can re-enter _transfer before swapAndLiquify completes
External router swap callback into the token can re-enter _transfer while the lock flag is set
Router sends ETH back during the swap, invoking receive() while swapAndLiquify is executing
sender parameter flows through _transfer balance and blacklist checks
recipient parameter flows through _transfer balance and wallet limit checks
amount parameter is subtracted from sender balance inside _transfer
finalAmount local is credited to the recipient inside _transfer
contractTokenBalance local is forwarded as tAmount into swapAndLiquify
amount parameter is used to compute feeAmount inside takeFee
feeAmount local derives from _tax or _antisniperblock division inside takeFee
tAmount parameter is split into tokensForLP and tokensForSwap in swapAndLiquify
tokensForLP local is passed as tokenAmount into addLiquidity
amountReceived local funds the ETH payouts through transferToAddressETH
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value in addLiquidity
newRouterAddress parameter is cast to the router interface in changeRouterVersion
time parameter is added to block.timestamp when setting _lockTime in lock
account parameter is the key written in isBlacklisted by blacklistAddress
